profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. The company says it supports a global ecosystem of customers and partners with process technology and design enablement solutions for the semiconductor industry. Its site states that its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and that the company contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

Public records identify the company as a for-profit public company headquartered in Hsinchu, with ticker TSM. It also appears under the name Taiwan Semiconductor-SP ADR. SEC records associate it with CIK 0001046179. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or products are recorded in the available facts.

The available material does not name specific AI products. The company's presented focus is semiconductor foundry services rather than a particular AI product line.
